title: What is Performance Marketing?
objectives: Explain performance marketing in one clear sentence
Identify the difference between paid ads and organic posts
Understand how cost per result works with simple math

blocks.text: Hi! Welcome to AdQuest. Today we learn how businesses pay for real results, not empty views.
Traditional ads like billboards or magazine posters cost money whether anyone buys or not.

blocks.title: The Tea Stall Analogy
blocks.text: Imagine a tea stall owner pays a helper ₹5 for every customer he brings inside. That is performance marketing: you pay for measurable results.

right.title: Paid Performance Ads
points: You choose exactly who sees it

blocks.title: The 4-Step Marketing Funnel
items: 3. Submit a lead form or message

blocks.text: In performance marketing, every single rupee you spend is tracked against the outcome it produces.
Views alone are not results. A million views with zero customer inquiries is a wasted budget.

quiz.q: A bakery spends ₹2,000 on ads and gets 40 cake inquiries. What is the cost per inquiry?
quiz.hint: Divide total money spent by the number of results.
quiz.explain: ₹2,000 ÷ 40 = ₹50 per inquiry. In advertising, we call this Cost Per Lead (CPL).

quiz.q: True or False: In performance marketing, a million views with zero sales is considered a big success.
quiz.hint: Performance marketing is judged by measurable business results, not vanity views.
quiz.explain: False. Views without actions do not pay the bills. Performance marketing focuses on measurable conversions.

quiz.q: What is the primary advantage of paid ads over organic posting?
options: Paid ads allow fast, predictable reach to your ideal customers
Paid ads require no photos or text
Paid ads guarantee a 100% purchase rate
quiz.hint: Think about speed and control over who sees your message.
quiz.explain: Paid ads let you reach targeted prospects immediately without waiting months for organic growth.

quiz.q: Put the customer funnel stages in the correct chronological order.
items: Click to view the salon menu
quiz.hint: Follow the journey from cold viewer to happy customer.
quiz.explain: A customer first sees the ad, clicks through, submits their details, and finally purchases.

recap: Performance marketing means paying for countable, measurable business results.
The funnel traces the journey from seeing an ad to becoming a paying customer.
